description: Readiness check for a set of dependencies (e.g. an AI app's stack: chatgpt, claude, aws, vercel, supabase, stripe). Returns overall verdict (worst of the set), ready=true only if all are up, and per-service status. Use before running jobs that depend on these services.

slugs.description: Services to check: slugs or common names, e.g. ['openai', 'stripe', 'vercel']

name: check_stack
title: Check a dependency stack
